meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 agent 容器里安装 Vercel CLI,并配置 OneCLI 自动注入 api.vercel.com 的凭证。之后 agent 就能把网页应用部署到 Vercel,还能列出部署、检查登录账号。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时会触发。若检测到 OneCLI 未就绪,会先让你运行 /init-onecli,再重试 /add-vercel。

say.text: 把我的网页应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境
列出我 Vercel 上的所有部署
看下当前 Vercel 登录的是哪个账号

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude installs the Vercel CLI into agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject api.vercel.com credentials. Agents can then deploy web apps to Vercel, list deployments, and check auth.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want agents to deploy web applications to Vercel. If OneCLI is missing, it asks you to run /init-onecli first, then retry /add-vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy my web app to Vercel production
Check which Vercel account is logged in
